The key table and the mouse buttons of SDL 3, for a host whose window and input run on the SDL of LWJGL.
Learn: [base-lwjgl3-sdl](/build/base-modules/lwjgl3-sdl/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`SdlKeys`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-sdl/sdlkeys/) | class | Maps the scancodes of SDL 3 to the keys of JOID and back, by physical position or through the keyboard layout. |
| [`SdlMouseButtons`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-sdl/sdlmousebuttons/) | class | Maps the mouse buttons of SDL 3, which count from 1, to the mouse buttons of JOID. |
